subject: Multivariate LCM varying ages at each time point

messages.author: 2c85ce61db0c7cae
messages.subject: Multivariate LCM varying ages at each time point
parts:
Hi all,

I am planning to run a multivariate latent curve model. I want to look at the relationship between 2 variables across 3 or 4 time points (in months: 10, 14, 24, 36). The issue is that the ages of the participants vary at each wave, (e.g., at time point 1, participants were aged between 8 months and 12 months, though the average is 10 months).

How can I deal with this issue in R? I am a beginner with these models so I would really appreciate any advice or suggestion!

Thanks,
Rena

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Multivariate LCM varying ages at each time point
parts:
If everyone has their own measurement schedule, then you can incorporate that schedule as a "definition variable" using OpenMx (or the TSCORES option in Mplus).

https://openmx.ssri.psu.edu/node/4839

But that is not available in lavaan.
